summary: Augment preceding function object with namespace exports.

source.pattern: function F(){} namespace F { export const x=1 }

target.notes: Model observable JavaScript emitted by TypeScript first, then reuse canonical JS class/module/object semantics.

tests.name: function property
tests.input: function F(){return 2}; namespace F { export const x=1 }; console.log(F(),F.x);

tests.name: identity
tests.input: function F(){}; const r=F; namespace F { export const x=1 }; console.log(r===F);
